The '''Aaris system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]]. The system's main [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Aaris III]], was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Aaris]] [[Species/Legends|species]], who established an industrial society several thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The Aaris were plunged into [[Aaris civil war|civil war]] with the discovery of the [[Plaque of Victory]], an inanimate [[Sentience/Legends|lifeform]] that fed off the life energy of other beings by heightening the Aaris's feelings of hostility and paranoia. The war reduced the Aaris to a primitive state, in which they were considered extinct by the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The Aaris system was relatively undisturbed for several thousand years until an [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeological]] [[MS-133|team]] was dispatched to Aaris III in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. During the expedition, the team discovered the Plaque of Victory and was subsequently [[Mission to Aaris III|attacked]] by the remnants of the Aaris. Only two members of the expedition survived to be rescued by the crew of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]''.

==Description==
The Aaris [[Star system/Legends|system]]<ref name="DarkStryder note">Page 5 of ''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]''{{'s}} Adventure Book states that [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] and primary [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] share the same name unless otherwise noted.</ref> was located within the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]]<ref name="TDC" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA-OC" /> The system was connected via [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Brolsam system/Legends|Brolsam]], [[Kolatill system/Legends|Kolatill]], and [[Charis system/Legends|Charis systems]]. [[Starship/Legends|Vessels]] transiting from Aaris took three [[Standard day/Legends|days]], nine [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] to reach [[Brolsam]], sixteen hours to get to [[Kolatill]], and one day, three hours to arrive at [[Charis]] by Class One [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].<ref name="TDC" /> The system's main [[Planet/Legends|world]], [[Aaris III]], was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Aaris]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="AOA" />

==History==
{{Quote|Six days since the arrival of the 'Plaque of Victory' our city is wracked by violence. First it was minor&mdash;a small surge in crimes, most resulting in the victims' deaths. Then it became more pronounced, with small gangs ruling the streets, clashing in bloody battles at every corner and gate.|Kastays, from the translation notes of Imperial scientist Grigor Tansad|<ref name="AOA" />}}
[[File:Tritiontraderoute.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The Trition Trade Route, showing the Aaris system in relation to the rest of the Kathol sector]]
The Aaris system's primary planet, Aaris III, was home to the Aaris, a species of [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] whose civilization flourished several thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A generally peaceful race, the Aaris developed an industrial society and constructed great network of [[City/Legends|cities]] across the planet that housed professionals such as scholars and [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]]s. However,<ref name="AOA" /> sometime before [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> the discovery of the [[Plaque of Victory]] on the planet precipitated the downfall of the Aaris civilization. The Plaque of Victory was an inanimate metal ingot containing a [[Sentience/Legends|lifeform]] that fed off the energy of other living beings by heightening their paranoia and violent tendencies. The Plaque's influence plunged the Aaris into a [[Aaris civil war|civil war]] that devastated their civilization. Their great cities were abandoned and left to ruin, and the Aaris descended into a primitive race living in the underground warrens of their former constructs.<ref name="AOA" />

The Aaris system was generally left alone for thousands of years.<ref name="AOA" /> During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], [[Scavenger/Legends|scavengers]] traveled to Aaris III in search of rare materials and valuables, looting the abandoned cities.<ref name="Remains">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Scavenging|The Remains of Aaris}}</ref> The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire also maintained holdings on the planet, with the [[Imperial Science Bureau (Sith Empire)|Imperial Science Bureau]] conducting [[Project Chimera]], which was responsible for studying the effects that the [[Nightmare Lands]] on the planet [[Voss]] had on non-native lifeforms.<ref name="Chimera" />

Shortly after [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] was appointed to control the Kathol [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], he sent to Aaris III a [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] expedition, which left a standard [[marker beacon]] on the surface. He later established a supply cache on the planet. A group of outlaws also set up a base on the planet at some point. At no point was it discovered that the Aaris species still existed, and the inhabitants of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at large believed that they were extinct. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], Sarne authorized an [[Mission to Aaris III|expedition]] to Aaris III to excavate the ruins and determine the cause of the Aaris's extinction. While on the planet, the team&mdash;designated [[MS-133]] and led by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Lancer Brunou]]&mdash;discovered the Plaque of Victory. Shortly after, the team members were attacked<ref name="AOA" /> by the Aaris.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|154|Jelok}}</ref> Over the course of several days, the natives [[Death/Legends|killed]] off the team until only Brunou and his research assistant, [[Solla Deremot]], remained alive to be rescued by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]''.<ref name="AOA" />

==Orbital bodies==
{{Main|Aaris III}}
Aaris III was a lush, [[Color/Legends|blue]]-green world covered in jungles and [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]], with high [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] ranges punching through the foliage canopy. Large cities, constructed by the Aaris, were located across the planet, all of which had fallen into ruin by 8 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]]. The Aaris were native to the planet but were believed by the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] to be extinct by 8 ABY due to a civil war that had devastated their society thousands of years prior.<ref name="AOA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Aaris system was created for ''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'', a [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game|roleplaying game]] sourcebook published by [[West End Games]] in [[1995]]. The system was featured in the [[Roleplaying game|RPG]] adventure ''[[Artifact of Aaris]]'', which was the second scenario in the sourcebook. The system's main world, Aaris III, was the primary setting for the adventure, written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer]]. Although Aaris III's name indicates that the system has at least three planetary bodies, no reference is made to any other planet in the Aaris system.<ref name="AOA" />
